contexts: Six fresh buyer contexts; three fresh seller contexts; each buyer review continued its own original context.
prompt_delivery: Each role permitted to read exactly its assigned frozen prompt file, no other files/network/writes; reviewer prompt derived only from frozen template plus that branch actual prior outputs.
ledger: Existing Market, independent initial90/40 per scenario; deterministic fictional delivery; snapshots persisted before review calls; final replay includes actual accepted reviews.
limits: No real spend, receipt, product test, customer or margin result.
